verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of npm verifying fetched packages against checksums, signatures, or attestations. The closest items are adjacent: a search filter that excludes insecure packages, plus community workarounds (`ignore-scripts`, `min-release-age`, bwrap sandboxing) that limit harm rather than verify integrity. None of these count as verification of packages before they run.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can trust that fetched packages are verified against checksums, signatures, or attestations before they run
